no_recruitment_is_where_many_teams_start: No. Recruitment is where many teams start with us, but we also build people growth, performance and culture systems — often for the same team as they scale.
usually_4_8_weeks_per_role_from_the_firs: Usually 4–8 weeks per role, from the first brief to a signed offer — with you involved at the moments that matter, not buried in CVs.
if_the_candidate_leaves_or_both_sides_ag: If the candidate leaves, or both sides agree the fit isn't working within 90 days, we run a new search at no extra charge. It's built into every engagement, not a special add-on.
upon_written_confirmation_the_candidate_: Upon written confirmation the candidate has accepted the offer — not at placement. If they don't start, there's no fee.
yes_most_of_our_work_is_with_growing_stu: Yes — most of our work is with growing studios and lean in-house teams, from 5 people up. That's exactly where every people decision counts the most.
yes_each_role_is_its_own_engagement_and_: Yes — each role is its own engagement, and multi-role bundles (three or more roles at once) qualify for a bundled rate.
we_work_remotely_with_teams_anywhere_and: We work remotely with teams anywhere, and on-site when it helps. Wherever your team is, we plug into how you already work.
